scope: The surviving low masonry and Ziyara-i Ibrahim at the Palace of Sultan Mas'ud III archaeological site in Ghazni as seen in June 2010.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The Italian mission published 42 by 20 metres for the excavated open court and found that most unearthed structures had disappeared by 2002. The badly damaged ziyara still stood above the western iwan.
The excavators report a four-iwan palace plan and the domed ziyara of Ibrahim above the west side of the palace.
Documents the 32-by-50-metre courtyard, northwest-to-southeast axis and damage to the palace archaeological site.
